verdict.rationale: The docs mention exporting to Roam JSON and standard Markdown formats, and community posts reference switching from Roam, but there is no evidence of an actual import feature for Notion, Evernote, or Roam files, nor any guarantee that links/attachments are preserved on import. One community comment even notes markdown compatibility issues with other apps, undercutting the 'preserved structure' claim. Missing for 10: dedicated Notion/Evernote/Roam import tooling, documentation of link/attachment preservation during import, and any first-party or independent report of a successful import migration.
